text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tension in northern Israel because of Syrian troop movements in Lebanon.
- Prime Minister Netanyahu: Rabin agreed indirectly to full Israeli pullout from the Golan Heights.
- Netanyahu: Syrian President Assad has not replied to messages I sent him.
- August CPI forecast at 0.5 to 0.8 percent.
- Netanyahu to hold more consultations with Treasury, Bank of Israel on budget cuts.
- Israeli army watching Syrian army movements on the Golan and in Lebanon.
- Netanyahu: I will discuss soon the timing for lowering interest rates in tandem with budget cuts.
- Banks estimate 1.5 billion shekel to two billion shekel net redemptions in provident funds in October.
- Israeli army watching Syrian troop movements.
- Netanyahu: Rabin's unofficial agreements aren't binding.
- Jewish New Year Rosh Hashana begins tonight.
